data.description:
## Goal

Add a data-driven `health` field to the enemy-config pipeline so regular enemies
can have more than one hit point without code changes. It defaults to `1`, so
every existing archetype is semantically unchanged.

Part of **Harvester enemy (AH-0MUI820PM0038HS2)**, feature **F1**. Covers
parent AC1 (health column/config) and AC4 (existing enemies unchanged). This is
the first feature in the plan's dependency order (F1 → F8).

## User story

As a designer, I want enemy health to be a CSV-config value, so I can tune a
multi-hit enemy (the Harvester, `health = 5`) without touching scene code.

## Scope

- `src/core/configTypes.ts` — add typed `health` to `EnemyConfig` (documented
  default `1`).
- `src/core/csv.ts` — add `health` to `ENEMY_COLUMN_ORDER`, coerce with the
  default `1`, and validate per the existing codec conventions.
- `src/core/configDefaults.ts` — add `health: 1` to every existing seed in
  `DEFAULT_ENEMY_CONFIGS`.
- `src/data/enemy-configs.csv` — add a `health` column (documented in the `#`
  header) with `1` on every existing row.
- Tests written first: `src/core/csv.test.ts`, `src/core/enemyConfig.test.ts`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `health` is present in `ENEMY_COLUMN_ORDER` and round-trips
  (`parse → serialize → parse`) for every archetype.
- A missing or malformed `health` coerces to the documented default `1`;
  non-positive/non-integer values are handled per the existing codec validation
  conventions.
- `EnemyConfig.health` is typed and every existing `DEFAULT_ENEMY_CONFIGS` seed
  carries `health: 1`.
- `src/data/enemy-configs.csv` carries the `health` column on every row; a
  missing/malformed file still falls back to the seed defaults without
  throwing.
- Config codec/seed tests pass and existing archetypes are semantically
  unchanged.
- Existing enemies are unchanged (AC4): all current 1-HP enemies (Scout,
  Diver, Tank, Phaser, Swarm, Asteroid) remain destroyed by one hit.

## Key Files

- `src/core/configTypes.ts`
- `src/core/csv.ts`
- `src/core/configDefaults.ts`
- `src/data/enemy-configs.csv`
- `src/core/csv.test.ts`
- `src/core/enemyConfig.test.ts`

## Constraints

- Health is data-driven; no per-enemy hard-coded branch.
- No regression: `health` defaults to `1`.
- UK English in all written output.
